name: Guile Branco
biography: Guile Branco is a Brazilian-born, Los Angeles–based actor and producer known for his work in independent film. Trained under Brazilian horror legend José Mojica Marins, he began his career onstage in São Paulo before moving to the U.S. to expand into film and television. A versatile performer fluent in multiple accents, Branco has appeared in a range of international projects and recently directed and starred in the acclaimed indie horror-comedy "A Halloween Feast". Now a U.S. citizen, he continues to develop and act in character-driven genre films across both Brazil and the United States.
